subject: Where is my order?
body: Hi, I ordered the indigo Dabu bedsheet 6 days ago (order ST-10482) and it still hasn't arrived. Can you tell me when it will reach Pune?

subject: Return cushion covers
body: Hello, the two silk cushion covers from order ST-10377 are lovely but the colour doesn't match my sofa. They are unused with tags. How do I return them?

subject: Torn bedsheet - want refund
body: The bedsheet in order ST-10290 arrived with a big tear along the border. I want a full refund for the whole order, Rs 4,800. Photos attached.

subject: THIRD email - no response!!
body: This is the third time I am writing. My curtains (order ST-10155) were shipped on 24 October and still have not come. Worst service ever. If I don't hear back today I will file a complaint in consumer court.

subject: Washing question
body: Hi! Can I put the Dabu print bedsheet in the washing machine? I don't want the colour to run.

subject: Shipping to Canada
body: Hello, do you ship to Toronto, Canada? How long would delivery take and would I have to pay customs?

subject: Bulk order for our hotel
body: We run a 30-room boutique hotel in Udaipur and need 60 king bedsheets with pillow covers by January. Do you offer wholesale pricing?

subject: Boost your SEO ranking 300% this month
body: Dear website owner, we guarantee first page Google ranking with our premium backlinks package. Reply YES to claim 70% off today only.

subject: Order status
body: Hi, can you check the status of order ST-99999? I placed it last week.

subject: Return the jute rug?

subject: Please cancel my order
body: Hi, I placed order ST-10560 this morning by mistake. Please cancel it.

subject: Order kab aayega

subject: Thank you!
body: Just wanted to say the table runner is beautiful and arrived beautifully packed. Thank you so much!

subject: Bedsheet size and gift wrap

subject: Your account will be suspended

subject: Stop my order
body: Please stop order ST-10560 before it ships, I ordered the wrong colour.

subject: Stocking your rugs

subject: Nagpur

subject: Silk?

subject: Very disappointed
